description: Unify Dashboard width reads onto Ink 7's useWindowSize() hook, preserving CAM-306 resize/clear semantics.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Ink 7 exposes useWindowSize(), a React hook returning { columns: number, rows: number } that re-renders the component on terminal resize (confirmed against node_modules/ink/build/hooks/use-window-size.d.ts). Direct drop-in for the raw stdout?.columns reads.

userStories.title: Read Dashboard width via Ink useWindowSize()
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need the Dashboard to read terminal width via Ink 7's useWindowSize() hook instead of the raw Node stdout?.columns TTY API, so that width reads are idiomatic and consistent across the component while keeping the CAM-306 resize/clear behavior identical.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard.tsx imports useWindowSize from 'ink' and reads columns from it. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'useWindowSize' src/ui/Dashboard.tsx]

The render-scoped divider/bar width (formerly `const cols = stdout?.columns ?? 80` at line ~189) is derived from useWindowSize()'s columns. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'useWindowSize' src/ui/Dashboard.tsx]

The poll-tick freshness site (formerly `pollClearer.onPollTick(stdout?.columns ?? 80)` at line ~211) no longer reads raw stdout?.columns; the width-change frame-clear stays correct because the columns value from useWindowSize is included in the interval effect's dependency array so the closure is refreshed on resize. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'stdout?.columns' src/ui/Dashboard.tsx]
The width-change frame-clear behavior (CAM-306) and overall render output are unchanged (makePollWidthClearer/onPollTick contract untouched). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Existing dashboard tests pass unchanged. [oracle: bun test test/dashboard.test.ts test/ui/dashboard-story-row.test.tsx]
Verify the screen renders correctly (Dashboard still paints via ink-testing-library and existing dashboard tests). [oracle: bun test test/ui/dashboard-story-row.test.tsx]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
check:all is green. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file change: src/ui/Dashboard.tsx. Two current sites read raw TTY width: line ~189 (`const cols = stdout?.columns ?? 80`, feeds dividerWidth/barWidth/initial pollClearer width) and line ~211 inside the setInterval (`pollClearer.onPollTick(stdout?.columns ?? 80)`). Replace both with Ink 7 useWindowSize() -> { columns }. GOTCHA (freshness): the original poll-tick read stdout?.columns directly precisely BECAUSE the render-scoped `cols` could be stale mid-interval (the effect dep was `stdout`, a stable object). useWindowSize re-renders on SIGWINCH, so add the hook's `columns` value to the interval useEffect dependency array (currently [pollIntervalMs, readSnapshot, stdout, pollClearer]) so the closure captures the updated width and the CAM-306 frame-clear still fires on resize. Do NOT change makePollWidthClearer / PollWidthClearer contract. OUT OF SCOPE: src/commands/dashboard.ts:251 (`process.stdout.columns`) is the non-interactive print path, not the Ink component, and is not part of this refactor. Keep the useStdout()/writeFn plumbing that pollClearer needs for writes. Ink success/failure glyph invariant is not touched here. Confirm final `grep -c stdout?.columns src/ui/Dashboard.tsx` is 0.
